question: What is the meaning of life cycle assessment (lca) in relation to product safety, health, environmental?
description: Life Cycle Assessment (LCA) is a methodology used to analyze and quantify the environmental aspects and impacts of product systems over their entire life cycle. This includes materials, products, processes, and buildings. LCA is applied in product development and improvement to consider factors such as product safety, health, and environmental impacts. It helps in assessing the overall sustainability and environmental performance of products by considering various stages from raw material extraction to disposal or recycling.
